title: Prophecy of Khalsa Triumph After Hardship

blocks.text: The passage answers persecution with prophecy. It says that the power which inflicted so much suffering on the Khalsa would not stand, and that Punjab would come into the hands of the Singhs after this season of trial.

The page then turns to scriptural reinforcement, drawing on saint-centered wisdom to argue that those who attack the holy ultimately lose all refuge. In that frame, the enemies of the Panth are not merely political rivals but offenders against a divine order already moving toward judgment.

Even in fragmentary OCR, the movement is clear: hardship is temporary, while the Guru's community is being prepared for visible ascendancy. The tone is meant to steady morale, not simply to predict victory.
